name: Pharaoh's Pyramid
text: After scoring, your team gains +10 points for every 50 gold you have.
archetypes: Gold Miner; splash Diamond Flood, Swap Meet
family: Gold and points conversion / Gold to points
decision: At every shop, whether to spend gold on a sigil or bank it for points.
opponent: Visible each round; no effect on opponents' cards.
aiNote: Spend normally through round 8, then buy only offers worth more than 10 gold per point and bank the rest.
rationale: Pays about +50 flat points a round at the 250 gold where interest stops growing, and about +100 at 500, without spending the gold. Holding that much means skipping purchases, so the cost is the sigils you don't buy; it compares with Spendthrift's Wallet (OR-R03), which pays 1 point per gold once, by paying 0.2 per gold every round. Gold is counted before the round's income, and the points count toward this round's 1,000 check.
